signature: properties(after: String, cultureName: String, filter: String, first: Int, storeId: String!, types: [PropertyType]): PropertyConnection

args.name: after
args.description: Only return edges after the specified cursor.

args.name: cultureName
args.description: The language for which all localized property dictionary items will be returned

args.name: filter
args.description: This parameter applies a filter to the query results

args.name: first
args.description: Specifies the maximum number of edges to return, starting after the cursor specified by 'after', or the first number of edges if 'after' is not specified.

args.name: storeId
args.description: The store id to get associated catalog

args.name: types
args.description: The owner types (Catalog, Category, Product, Variation)
